ui.app_tagline: Understand your letter in plain words.
ui.privacy_badge: Your letter stays on this device.
ui.privacy_detail: Plainread runs on your own computer. Your letter is never sent over the internet.
ui.paste_placeholder: Paste or type the words from your letter here.
ui.drop_here: Or drag a photo or PDF here.
ui.use_ai: Use local AI for better summaries and full translation
ui.ai_unavailable: Local AI is not running. Plainread still works, but some sentences stay in English.
ui.working: Reading your letter. This can take a minute.
ui.footer: Plainread is free and open source. It works without the internet.
ui.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
ui.error_too_big: That file is too big. Try a smaller photo.
ui.error_type: That kind of file does not work here. Use a photo (JPG or PNG) or a PDF.
ui.error_empty: Add a photo, a PDF or the letter text first.
ui.nothing_found: We did not find anything for this part.

sections.consequences: What happens if you do nothing

summary.no_dates: We did not find any deadlines. Read the letter carefully to be sure.
summary.dates_one: There is 1 important date. It is {date} ({relative}).
summary.dates_other: There are {count} important dates. The next one is {date} ({relative}).
summary.actions_one: There is 1 thing you need to do.
summary.actions_other: There are {count} things you need to do.
summary.no_actions: We did not find anything you must do.

contacts.tty: TTY (for people who are deaf or hard of hearing)

notes.calc_days_from_letter: Plainread counted {count} days from the letter date ({anchor}).
notes.calc_business_days: Plainread counted {count} business days (Monday to Friday) from {anchor}. Holidays can change this.
notes.calc_from_receipt: The letter counts from the day you got it. To be safe, Plainread counted from the letter date ({anchor}).
notes.calc_from_today: The letter does not show its date, so Plainread counted from today ({anchor}).
notes.year_guessed: The letter does not give a year for this date. Plainread guessed {year}.

warnings.low_ocr_confidence: Parts of the photo were hard to read. Check the letter text below, or take a clearer photo in good light.
warnings.no_text: We could not find any words. Try a clearer photo, or paste the text.
warnings.ocr_unavailable: Photo reading (Tesseract) is not installed on this computer. You can paste the letter text instead.
warnings.ai_dropped_one: The local AI wrote 1 statement we could not find in the letter, so we removed it.
warnings.ai_dropped_other: The local AI wrote {count} statements we could not find in the letter, so we removed them.
warnings.ai_failed: The local AI did not answer, so we used the basic explainer.
warnings.english_sentences: Some sentences from the letter are shown in English. Turn on local AI for a full translation.
warnings.not_advice: Plainread helps you understand a letter. It is not legal, medical or money advice. If you are not sure, call the phone number on the letter or ask someone you trust.

reading_level: This letter is written at about a grade {grade} reading level. Many adults find this hard.
